feature_contract.goal: Ensure native car selection DDS formats preserve the source-declared opacity and alpha for all supported 16-bit RGB pixel-mask layouts without whitening menu textures or corrupting the original game's fallback.
feature_contract.scope_boundary: Only vehicle-selector DDS RGB 565/X1R5G5B5/A1R5G5B5/A4R4G4B4 and 24-bit decode intent; preserve all unsupported DDS native D3DX fallback, sprite lifetime, input, FFB, SkyGlow, DX11, and frozen DXVK.
trace_stages: Native OutRun car-selection DDS pixel-format header carries flags and RGB/alpha masks into src/hooks_textures.cpp::GetD3DFormatFromPixelFormat.
GetD3DFormatFromPixelFormat dispatches Classify16 in dds_alpha_mask_policy.hpp into D3D9 X1/A1/A4/565 formats or D3DFMT_UNKNOWN for native D3DX fallback.
Original D3D9 texture resource and selector sprites reach the vehicle-selection UI and existing R84 left/right eye OpenXR composition without changing reset, draw, or game input semantics.
subcomponents: Classify 16-bit RGB-only 555 high-bit mask as opaque X1 and declared 1-bit alpha as A1; map valid 565 and declared 4444 independently in C++.
Reject undeclared 4444 alpha, conflicting FOURCC or 565 alpha, and malformed BGR24 metadata to native D3DX; keep existing 32-bit RGB opacity handling.
Exercise positive, malformed and fallback format mutations in compile-time checks and vrhost/tests/dds_alpha_mask_smoke.cpp, then run mandatory final exact-SHA CI.

acceptance_items.expected_behavior: Opaque 555 and 565 formats do not manufacture transparency; declared A1 and A4 formats map to their matching D3D9 alpha textures.
Ambiguous or conflicting RGB alpha/FourCC source masks are rejected for fast conversion and retain the unchanged native D3DX decoder.
Final validation-bearing exact SHA must pass required DX9Ex Active Windows game, host and package jobs, Domain Isolation, HUD Inspector and Full Source Impact; HMD remains UNTESTED.

diagnosis.original_evidence: Previously committed ed12dbf1863afac17bf6859da3d720e303711e08 changed source DDS classifier, C++ compile-time format checks and executable DDS smoke; GitHub Actions 39192719006 failed before build because the exact task record was absent.
diagnosis.root_cause: Existing fast DDS decode mapped some 16-bit formats by bit masks without considering DDPF_ALPHAPIXELS declaration and could manufacture transparency or assume malformed alpha; a separate CI policy failure occurred because the prior material commit omitted docs/automation/runs/CONVERSION-DX9EX-01072.json.
source_trace: Game vehicle-select DDS pixel format flags and bit masks enter GetD3DFormatFromPixelFormat in hooks_textures.cpp.
DdsAlphaMask::Classify16 distinguishes RGB-only X1 from declared A1/A4 and 565; unsupported formats return UNKNOWN to the untouched native D3DX path.
Native menu texture resource is consumed by the original game sprite/selection draw and R84 OpenXR host composition, with actual Quest3/VDXR imagery still unverified.
diagnosis.eye_ownership: This source fix only ensures texture upload semantics before R84 left/right eye composition; it does not prove physical binocular vehicle selection without Quest3.
alternatives_rejected: Do not blindly map high alpha-shaped bits to transparency when DDS metadata has no ALPHAPIXELS flag.
Do not bypass native D3DX decoding for unrecognized formats or alter unrelated R84 stereo HUD, SkyGlow, input or FFB to hide white selector sprites.

ci_evidence.prior_failure: Run-record missing in exact-HEAD feature-policy gate, remaining jobs skipped; not evidence of compile failure

next_action: COMPLETE_BUILD_VERIFIED at the exact validation-bearing SHA; Quest3/VDXR car-selection optical/runtime acceptance remains NEED_HMD_TEST. No further exact-SHA CI rerun or duplicate score on C6.
